financialWrites: Explicit SYNTHETIC QA void/refund workflow only

checks.name: GRIDIRON sign-in opens the real private Wallet with secure cookies
The exact already-recorded QA contract is reconciled through the UI without repeating its purchase; its actual refund preserves P/L
The private AI screen transparently calculates recorded withdrawals and P/L, streams the real report and exposes its source
Saved private game questions and explanations open in the consumer interface
A fresh browser session reopens the exact same persistent Wallet
Another fresh sign-in retains the same private conversation and messages

limitations: Uses only the explicitly provisioned disposable QA identity; all financial fixtures are clearly synthetic and no wager is placed externally.
Tests real iPhone-sized webkit UI and HTTPS app sessions, not a physical Safari device.
